Executive Finding · Layer 3 interpretation

What the year has been saying so far

From January through mid-September 2026 (PHT), Facebook carried the clinic’s distribution muscle — 531,353 page media views and 140,926 video views across the retrieved daily series — while Instagram, on a smaller audience (635 followers), concentrated interaction density (19,525 total interactions YTD, mostly likes). TikTok (@enhance_clinic_launion, 386 followers) added a third public-video layer: 125 YTD public videos totaling 48,525 views and 2,717 engagements (likes+comments+shares) — led by practical pain-education clips, with stroke/progress stories also appearing at smaller absolute reach. Alongside that feed performance, Meta Business Suite Messaging (Facebook, Jan 1–Sep 16) shows 480 messaging conversations started with a 56% response rate — volume is up sharply vs the prior comparable window, while appointments/leads attributed in Suite remain small (1 appointment, 2 leads). Audience demographics (Facebook lifetime followers) are women-skewed (~72% women) with top cities in La Union (Bauang, San Fernando, Baguio, Naguilian, Agoo) — consistent with a local catchment story, not proof of visits. The story underneath those totals is consistent: recovery narratives and practical pain education travel; conversation and website CTAs remain thin.

January: recovery stories carried Facebook shares

In mid-January, a Cedric skin-graft recovery series and a “serious leg break → stepping forward” progress post landed close together. Those posts coincided with elevated share and reaction totals on Facebook — the leg-break post later showed 26,498 lifetime post media views when sampled — without implying those views converted into clinic visits.

Cedric: 150 reactions · 30 sharesLeg break: 141 reactions · 32 shares26,498 post media views

Early March: knee “rayuma” education peaked shares and IG likes

On Mar 3 (PHT window), the same knee-rayuma education creative appeared on both channels. On Facebook it was the YTD share leader among retrieved posts (48 shares). On Instagram the matching reel sat among the highest like counts (159 likes). March also recorded the strongest Facebook follower month-end rise in the daily follows series (+62 vs prior month-end).

FB 48 shares · 75 reactionsIG 159 likesFB followers +62 in March

March stroke cluster: IG likes clustered around patient progress

Within days of the knee post, Instagram published a stroke-trust reel (165 likes) and Ms. Marcelina’s session-by-session recovery feed post (163 likes). That cluster sat inside Instagram’s densest like week in the retrieved YTD media list — suggestive of affinity for recovery storytelling on IG, not proof of acquisition.

Stroke trust reel · 165 likesMarcelina · 163 likes

Summer exception: elbow education unlocked rare IG comments

Across YTD Instagram account insights, comments totaled only 50 — a thin conversational footprint relative to 18,869 likes. A June elbow (“siko”) education post was an outlier with 10 comments and 111 likes, suggesting question-led pain education can still spark replies when the creative invites them.

10 comments on postIG YTD comments 50

Hiring outlier: recruitment dominated reactions, not clinical themes

The February licensed physiotherapist hiring post produced 1,130 reactions — far above clinical posts — and 22,605 sampled post media views. Treat this as a separate content class when reading engagement averages; clinical share leaders remain the recovery and education posts above.

1,130 reactions22,605 post media views

TikTok YTD standout: neck–headache education led public views

Among 125 public TikTok videos retrieved for Jan 1–Sep 17, 2026 (PHT), a neck-pain education clip (“Masakit ang leeg… sumasakit ang ulo?”) led the set with 5,003 views and 84 engagements (likes+comments+shares). That sits well above the YTD per-video average (~388 views) — consistent with practical pain-education travel on short video, without implying clinic visits.

TT 5,003 views69 likes · 15 sharesYTD public views sum 48,525

Stroke recovery also surfaces on TikTok — smaller absolute reach, same theme

A September Ms. Satelyn stroke-recovery journey video and an earlier “stroke patients trust us” clip returned 530 and 791 views respectively, with 13 and 31 likes. Absolute numbers trail Facebook’s distribution muscle, but the theme matches the FB/IG recovery cluster — suggestive that consented progress stories still resonate when cut for TikTok, not proof of acquisition.

Satelyn stroke · 530 views · 13 likesStroke trust · 791 views · 31 likes

Closing implication. The content that coincided with the strongest share, like, and TikTok view clusters — stroke recovery, knee/shoulder/neck education, patient progress — is the pattern to double down on for Q4 2026 and early 2027 across Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. The gaps that show up in the same data (scarce IG comments, zero returned website clicks, zero page total actions) are the experiments worth designing next — outlined in Content Strategy below. None of these relationships prove patient acquisition; they describe what audiences amplified.

06

Content strategy for succeeding months

Oct–Dec 2026 into 2027 Q1. LAYER 3 · INTERPRETATION Recommendations are grounded only in patterns observed above — testable, not guaranteed outcomes.

DOUBLE DOWN · FACEBOOK

Share-driving recovery stories

  • Keep a steady series of named (consented) progress stories — stroke, post-op, knee/shoulder — matching January–March share leaders.
  • Pair each story with one plain-language education beat within 48 hours (the Mar 3–5 cluster pattern).
  • Track shares + reactions as the primary FB creative score; sample post_media_view on top performers.
FIX · INSTAGRAM

Comment prompts & conversation

  • YTD IG comments (50) are low vs likes (18,869). Replicate the June elbow post pattern: symptom question + clear next step in-caption.
  • Test one “reply with your symptom” Reel weekly; measure comment count, not vanity likes alone.
  • When followers cross 1,000, enable media insights to validate watch-time — currently blocked at 635.
CADENCE

Hold the rhythm, sharpen clusters

  • Maintain ~20–25 posts/month on FB/IG and ~13–17 public videos/month on TikTok (observed Jan–Aug). Prefer intentional clusters over random daily posts.
  • Plan one “theme week” per month (stroke, workplace mobility, knee) echoing March’s follower lift window.
  • Keep Reels-first on IG (167/189 YTD) while mirroring strongest scripts to FB.
GROW · TIKTOK

Short-form pain education + recovery cuts

  • Replicate the neck–headache education pattern that led YTD public views (5,003) — symptom hook in the first line, plain-language reassurance, clear clinic cue.
  • Cut consented stroke/progress stories (e.g. Ms. Satelyn journey) into 20–40s vertical edits; theme already works on FB/IG and appears on TT with smaller absolute reach.
  • Hold ~13–17 public videos/month (observed Jan–Aug cadence). Comments are thin (11 YTD) — test one question sticker / reply CTA per week and measure replies, not likes alone.
  • Use Signal View ~28d (create_time window) for recent public video volume/views/engagement; do not invent follower deltas. Re-check if Login Kit later exposes account insights.
TEST NEXT

CTA & profile actions

  • IG website_clicks returned 0 and FB page_total_actions summed to 0 in retrieved windows — design explicit “message us / call” experiments and re-measure.
  • Separate hiring/recruitment content from clinical reporting so averages stay interpretable.
  • Do not claim patient acquisition from engagement; pair social tests with clinic intake tagging offline.

Notes & methodology

Reproducible pulls via Composio Meta + TikTok Login Kit Sandbox tools. Raw summaries saved under /workspace/ytd-2026-data/.

LAYER 1

Observed

API totals, daily series sums, post counters, retrieved media lists.

LAYER 2

Derived

Window aggregates, engagement scores, keyword theme hits, cadence charts.

LAYER 3

Interpreted

Executive Finding narrative and Content Strategy — cautious, correlational language only.

Coverage. Report window Jan 1, 2026 00:00 PHT → Sep 17, 2026 (time_info ≈ 2026-09-16T19:53Z). IG account insights requested as total_value for the full unix range (returned totals used as YTD) plus a ~28-day comparison window. FB page insights pulled in three day-period windows (≤90 days each) and summed for additive metrics; follower level uses series endpoints. IG media: 189 posts paginated in-range. FB posts: 204 unique posts via date windows (cursor pagination was unstable). Thumbnails embedded: 54 base64 images for cited/top posts (incl. TikTok covers). TikTok: 125 public YTD videos via TIKTOK_LIST_VIDEOS (paginated max_count=20 until create_time < Jan 1, 2026 00:00 PHT); profile stats via TIKTOK_GET_USER_STATS. Public videos only — private/friends-only omitted by API. TikTok ~28d Signal View computed from video create_time (PHT), not a separate account-insights API.
Facebook Messaging (Suite). Audience, responsiveness, conversations, outcomes, and messaging-ads KPIs transcribed from Meta Business Suite Messaging UI (Facebook selected; Jan 1–Sep 16, 2026). Ad account 756502045848834. Not Graph API. See section #facebook-messaging. No dual YTD/~28d Messaging split — shown as Suite-window period totals.
Audience & Demographics. Facebook follows/viewers/messaging-contact KPIs and lifetime-follower gender/age/geo transcribed from Meta Business Suite Audience screen capture (last ~28 days style for activity; demographics = lifetime followers). Instagram follower counts and follower_demographics from Instagram Graph API. TikTok shows Login Kit account stats only — age/gender/city/country not available via the current connection; no demographic charts invented. See #facebook-audience, #instagram-audience, #tiktok-audience.
Skipped / unavailable (not shown as empty cards). TikTok last-28-day account insights endpoint not available — Signal View ~28d for TikTok is computed from public video create_time (PHT) sums; profile followers/likes remain as-of-pull. TikTok paid/boosted not classified — Paid type omitted on TT panel. IG per-post follows and watch time were not returned by connected IG tools — those Top Posts sorts are omitted. IG website_clicks returned 0 — omitted from KPI grid. FB page_total_actions daily sum 0 — omitted. Classic impressions metrics not requested (deprecated/rejected). Facebook Messaging KPIs now included from Meta Business Suite Messaging screen capture (Jan 1–Sep 16, 2026; Facebook-only) — not Graph API; Returning contacts unsupported; zero-value Suite cards (contacts with orders, earnings, orders) omitted. Instagram Messaging not captured. Facebook Suite Audience (~28d follows/viewers + lifetime-follower demographics) and Instagram follower_demographics now included — see Audience sections. TikTok age/gender/city/country not available via current Login Kit scopes (stats-only Audience section; no empty demo cards). Unique Page viewers not available from connected tools. Top Posts sorts, Paid/Organic & Content Format. Both platforms support By engagement (IG: likes + comments; FB: reactions + 3×comments + 5×shares). By follows / By watch time omitted — no per-post values obtained.
